brief_rationale: The trajectory successfully completes all six responsibility-chain requirements without serious or minor errors, establishing safe care with appropriate urgency recognition. At least two high-order points (HO2 hidden state discovery and HO3 real-world constraint navigation) are triggered and actively completed with meaningful impact, meeting the threshold for Perfect. Closure is valid with family read-back confirming understanding of the plan, red flags, and privacy-appropriate diabetes disclosure.
